# Open Food Facts parser fixtures

Captured 2026-09-27 from the public v2 product API, requesting only the fields
used by the calorie adapter:

- https://world.openfoodfacts.org/api/v2/product/20995553 (solid chocolate)
- https://world.openfoodfacts.org/api/v2/product/5908260250522 (drink)
